description: Located in the highly desirable Natomas Park community, this beautifully maintained single story home offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with a bright, open concept floor plan built for comfort, functionality, and easy everyday living. From the moment you step inside, natural light, warm finishes, and a thoughtfully designed layout come together to create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The spacious family room sits at the center of the home and features a welcoming fireplace and a seamless connection to the dining area and kitchen, creating an ideal space for both relaxing nights in and casual entertaining. The kitchen is designed for both style and function with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and abundant cabinetry for storage. Durable laminate wood flooring flows through the main living areas, tying the space together with a clean, modern feel. The primary suite offers a private retreat with an ensuite bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub, separate shower stall, and a walk-in closet that checks every box for convenience and comfort. Two additional bedrooms provide flexible space for guests, work, or hobbies. A well placed hallway laundry area keeps daily routines efficient and out of the main living spaces. Major updates provide added peace of mind, including a brand new HVAC system installed in 2026 and a water heater replaced in 2023. The exterior features drought resistant landscaping, offering low maintenance curb appeal with water efficient design. Step outside to a covered patio and a generous backyard with extra side yard space, offering plenty of room for outdoor dining, gardening, entertaining, or future customization. As a resident of Natomas Park, you also enjoy access to resort style amenities including a clubhouse, pools, cabanas, and a fitness center, bringing a true vacation style lifestyle right to your neighborhood. Located in Sacramento, this home places you close to parks, schools, shopping, dining, and major freeway access, making commuting and daily errands simple and convenient. A true blend of location, layout, lifestyle, and upgrades, this home delivers everyday comfort with resort level amenities and meaningful system improvements already in place.
